title: Which identity providers support EU AMLR customer due diligence with eIDs and the EUDI Wallet?
summary: Identity providers for AMLR CDD with eIDs and EUDI Wallet: what the regulation requires, 6 providers compared and 5 questions to ask your provider.
body_markdown:
*Five questions buyers ask about AMLR-ready identity providers, what the regulation requires behind each one, and which providers document it publicly.*


Identity providers that support customer due diligence under the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR) offer electronic identification at assurance level substantial or high, accept the EU Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI Wallet), keep a remote document check as a fallback and record how every customer was verified. Providers that publicly document AMLR-related capabilities include Authologic, Didit, IDnow, Namirial, Signicat and WebID. They differ in which eID schemes are live, whether EUDI Wallet verification is live, certified or announced, and what evidence they give an obliged entity to show its supervisor.
